name: Hand-Thrown Speckled Stoneware Vase
description: A hand-thrown stoneware vase with a rounded, gently asymmetric body that tapers into a short cylindrical neck, finished in a matte speckled glaze.
materials: Hand-thrown stoneware clay body with a matte, flecked speckled glaze finish; unglazed footring.
primaryColors: Warm grey base with dense oatmeal speckle throughout
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, maker's mark, stamp, or logo on the vase; never add a printed or painted pattern; keep the glaze speckling random and non-repeating. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the same asymmetric rounded-body-to-cylindrical-neck silhouette, roughly 32cm proportions, warm-grey matte glaze with oatmeal speckle density, and unglazed footring consistent across all five angles.
